request: How large is the immigration court backlog and how has it changed over time?

reply.reply:
**The immigration-court backlog reached 3,558,995 pending cases at the end of FY2024, after growing each year since FY2006 and rising from nearly 2.5 million at FY2023-end.**

- EOIR had 3,558,995 immigration court cases pending at the end of FY2024. (IN12492, PDF p. 4)
- The backlog has grown each year since FY2006, passing 1 million in FY2019, reaching nearly 2.5 million at FY2023-end and approximately 3.6 million at FY2024-end. (IN12463, PDF p. 1)
- The backlog exceeded 1 million in FY2019 and continued to increase; CRS reported 1,405,386 million cases pending at FY2021-end. (R47077, PDF p. 21)
reply.reasoning: The newest CRS data provide an exact FY2024-end count; CRS trend reporting shows sustained growth from FY2006, over 1 million by FY2019, and nearly 2.5 million by FY2023-end. An older CRS report supplies FY2021 context, but the newer trend series is sufficient to answer.
